title: SG-6.4.4 · A 401 from Approve, Retry or Reject returns to the token gate
summary: A 401 from any of the three execution actions clears the admin token and shows the token gate, as the load path does.
description: Context: game/frontend/src/components/AdminApp.tsx already routes a 401 from runExecutionAction into handleError, which clears the token and sets gateError 'Invalid token'. Only the approve 401 path is tested, and handleError leaves earlier error and action-error state behind. Desired behavior: Approve, Retry and Reject each return to the token gate on 401, with no stale action error. Why: the admin must never see leftover errors or data after re-entering a token.
acceptance_criteria: Given an authenticated admin, when approve, retry or reject returns 401, then the Admin token field is shown with 'Invalid token'.
Given an earlier action error is displayed, when a later 401 occurs and the token is re-entered, then the old action error is not shown.

preserve: Non-401 action errors shown through actionError

definition_of_done: All three actions verified by unit tests
